about_short_description.short_description: Bynh is a virtual platform that allows people and small businesses to acquire legal services and consultations.

product.name: Text Legal Consultations
product.description: A service allowing clients to request legal advice and ask questions via text messages, supporting written, voice messages, images, and document attachments.

product.name: Audio and Video Legal Sessions
product.description: Real-time legal consultations through scheduled or instant audio or video calls with licensed lawyers to discuss specific legal matters.

product.name: Legal Procedures and Services
product.description: Comprehensive legal services including case study, court session attendance, legal representation, drafting legal documents, contract review, and execution requests.

product.name: Legal Consultations for Investment
product.description: Legal advisory services focused on investment activities, including company formation, licensing, compliance, contract negotiation, risk assessment, and dispute resolution.

product.name: Labor Law Legal Services
product.description: Legal services addressing labor disputes, contract issues, workers’ rights, and related employment law matters.

product.name: Legal Document Drafting and Review
product.description: Preparation and review of legal documents such as pleadings, contracts, objections, appeals, and other legal correspondence.
